priorityList: Ensure every non-Kill Command cast is affected by a Tip of the Spear stack.
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear stacks if you run out (generates 2 stacks with Primal Surge).
Cast Kill Command with 1 Tip stack if it has a Howl of the Pack Leader proc (glowing icon).
Activate Takedown, ideally with zero Tip of the Spear stacks, to generate 3 stacks while consuming one immediately.
Cast Raptor Strike (must be Tipped if upgraded to Raptor Swipe).
Cast Takedown as a filler if no other abilities are available.
Use Kill Command as frequently as possible to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks.
Avoid using Kill Command too aggressively to prevent over-capping Focus or wasting Tip of the Spear stacks.
Maintain a rotation cadence of using two abilities between each use of Kill Command.
Use Wildfire Bomb as frequently as possible on cooldown.
Ensure as many abilities as possible are buffed by Tip of the Spear and Strike as One enhancements.
